title: notopened Unified Quiz & Shorts Content Schema
description: Standard schema for dual-use content: Web Quiz Interactive Portal and Haru's YouTube Shorts Generation Pipeline.

format_type.description: One of Haru's 5 core Shorts formats

topic.description: Topic or category name (e.g. 항공/과학, 물리/생활, 조선역사)

question.description: Clean, punchy question text for web quiz portal

options.description: List of options for user selection

explanation.description: Clear educational explanation of why the answer is correct

target_duration_sec.description: Target shorts video runtime in seconds

hook_opening_3s.description: Immediate hook voiceover and screen headline for first 3 seconds

question_scene_10s.description: Voiceover TTS text and visual description presenting the quiz

countdown_scene_5s.description: Timer tick sound and tension cue (5 seconds)

answer_reveal_15s.description: Answer reveal and core punchline explanation

closing_cta_5s.description: Call to action directing viewers to pinned comment web quiz and mobile game

primary_source_name.description: Authoritative institution or peer-reviewed/official encyclopedia source

verification_basis.description: Specific scientific, legal, or historical citation proving factual accuracy

verified_by.description: Role/Agent that verified the fact (e.g. CBDO 카이)
